origin: Four visible questions preserved in an actual browser-restored v0.19.2-derived project. Captured from m1-review-first-conflict.coursemapper before resolving the 30/35/35 to 20/50/30 scoring change.

questions.question: What will I learn to do?
questions.answer: Explain how an amended record changes the interpretation of an earlier entry.

questions.question: What do I need to submit?
questions.answer: One annotated response with the reasoning, conclusion, and evidence limit; prose, a labeled diagram, or an equivalent accessible response.

questions.question: Which materials do I need?
questions.answer: Use the source record reproduced in the lesson plan and study guide. Label your reasoning separately from statements directly supplied by the record.

questions.question: How will my response be evaluated?
questions.answer: Identify and attribute evidence: 30%; Explain the reasoning and complete the task: 35%; State what the evidence leaves unresolved: 35%. Check the task rubric for the specific evidence at each level.
